name: duckboard
description: One pane that shows every Claude Code session on this computer.

addressName.title: Address name
addressName.description: If a reply line starts with this name and a comma or colon, the board drops it.

autoCompact.title: Auto compact
autoCompact.description: Compact an idle, warm session after the idle minutes below.

autoCompactIdleMinutes.title: Auto compact after idle minutes
autoCompactIdleMinutes.description: Must be under the 60 minute cache lifetime measured on this machine.

autoCompactMinTokens.title: Auto compact minimum context tokens
autoCompactMinTokens.description: Only compact sessions whose context is at least this size.
